services.name: SIP & STROLL RIVER RIDES
services.desc: Cruise with us to and from the monthly Sip & Stroll event that occurs the third Monday of each Month from 5-8 pm! We will depart from Riverfront Plaza on the Northbank at 5 pm and will drop you at Sip & Stroll. We will provide return trips from the Southbank to the Northbank at 7 pm, 7:30 pm, and 8 pm! Spanning from the DoubleTree Hotel to The Southbank Hotel, enjoy live music, food vendors, bars and a picnic area – all with a picturesque sunset backdrop. Alcoholic beverages in a branded Sip & Stroll cup are permitted on the Riverwalk during the event and are provided at either one of the Riverwalk bars. There is a $1 fee to purchase a 21+ wristband. services.name: Downtown Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy an educational and informative cruise on the St. Johns! We depart from the Doubletree Hotel Dock, just east of the Main Street Bridge on the Southbank Riverwalk. This narrated tour includes a brief history about Jacksonville, information about the St. Johns River and a chance to get a close look at wildlife that abounds in the downtown area. All ages are welcome on this tour. Please understand that dolphin sightings are very common but not guaranteed. Duration 1 Hour - Boarding is 10 minutes prior to published departures. services.desc: Take the River Taxi to and from the game! River Taxi service begins at least three hours before the game starts and continues until the Stadium dock is clear. We operate multiple boats and extend service hours for all game days. Please select your dock preference below. On game day, you simply go to the dock and check in to get your round trip wristband. For stadium transport, we pick up from two downtown river taxi docks on the Southbank (Doubletree and Marriott SOUTHBANK) and one dock on the Northbank (east end of Riverfront Plaza under the Blue Bridge).
